summary: Willamette NF L-4 cab built 1933; vandalized in 1962 and gone by 1965. Reached by a 9.6-mile hike from the Maxwell Butte Trailhead, near Detroit, Oregon.

facts.status_note: The cab was removed or destroyed by 1965. No source describes what remains on the summit today.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest (Detroit Ranger District)

staffing.status: lookout fireman named in a 1939 newspaper item

access.note: Hike on Maxwell Butte Trail #3391 from the trailhead. Entry permits are required to enter the Mt. Jefferson Wilderness from the trailhead June 15 to October 15; the Forest Service page lists two types of entry permit.

visit.trail_note: 9.6 miles, 2,500 ft gain (Oregon Hikers). Drive Highway 22 east 31 miles from Detroit to Maxwell Sno-Park, then Forest Road 080 for one mile to the trailhead.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Kemnow both give 1933. The 1934 date on the register's photo is the date of the panoramic photograph, not the build date.

notes_for_editor: Removal conflict: the register and Kemnow say removed in 1965, Kamstra says destroyed in 1965. The 1962 vandalism report is the only account of damage; no source describes the 1965 event itself. Staffing evidence is a single 1939 newspaper item. The Oregon Hikers and Forest Service pages were read for access and do not describe the summit today. The guide's 6,229 ft elevation and the 1939 item's 6,225 ft differ by a few feet; the record's 1898.6 m is consistent with either.
